title: Warehouse Receipts, Pledged Bushels and Transfers Off a Storage Agreement
content:
A negotiable warehouse receipt passes title, and what a receipt does to the bushels it names governs everything else that can be done with them. This clause of the terms covers receipts, pledges, transfers onto a marketing contract, and the two particulars of an agreement that may be rewritten, under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## The governing terms

1. A negotiable warehouse receipt is issued only on programmes the catalogue allows it on, and only once the member's stored-grain insurance certificate is on file where the programme requires it, because the receipt passes title and the elevator will not pass title on uninsured grain.

2. Issuing a receipt pledges the bushels it names, and those bushels move from free to reserved on the agreement and cannot be loaded out, transferred onto a marketing contract or pledged a second time while the receipt stands.

3. Cancelling the receipt at the programme's cancellation fee releases them again, and a receipt may be reduced rather than cancelled where only part of the bushels are needed.

4. Transferring stored bushels onto a marketing contract takes the programme's transfer fee per bushel and the programme's transfer shrink, and it is worked only on free bushels; the bushels leave the agreement on the day of transfer and storage stops accruing on them that day.

5. The grade of record is rewritten only on a completed recheck, never on the member's own reading, and the paid-through date is rewritten only when a settlement actually clears the charges behind it.

## The two tests behind a receipt

**The insurance test.** Whether the certificate is on file is read off the cooperative's own record of that agreement, against the agreement number printed on the member's storage statements, and it is read before the receipt is issued rather than after. A member's assurance that the cover is in place is not the test.

**The standing test.** A receipt or a pledge is written against an agreement that is live: one standing active, one on billing hold, or one in load-out. An agreement still in applied standing, one closed and one terminated are not agreements against which the pledged figure is rewritten.

## What a pledge shuts out

| While the receipt stands, the bushels it names | |
| --- | --- |
| may be loaded out | no |
| may be transferred onto a marketing contract | no |
| may be pledged a second time | no |
| come back to free on cancellation, at the programme's cancellation fee | yes |
| come back to free in part where the receipt is reduced instead | yes |

## When each particular of the agreement may be rewritten

| Particular | Rewritten only when |
| --- | --- |
| the grade of record | a recheck has been completed |
| the date storage is billed and paid through | a settlement has actually cleared the charges behind it |

Neither is rewritten on the member's own reading of the grain or on an intention to pay.
